name: kernel-platform-pc
description: The PC behind witos/platform.h (q35, QEMU's pc machine, VMware; plan step H1.1): COM1 console, QEMU test exit, the HPET of the ACPI HPET table, CMOS real-time clock, the processors of the ACPI MADT, PIC and PIT tick source, PCI enumeration through the configuration ports with the ECAM window of the ACPI MCFG.
